title: Lovely Lightly Grilled Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A high-protein Tunisian dish featuring lamb, coco sugar, and a crunchy texture, perfect for a post-workout meal, wrapped in a lotus leaf for added flavor and nutrition.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coco sugar, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wrap each kebab in a lotus leaf and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the leaf is crispy and slightly charred.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of quinoa or couscous.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Slice the kebabs into thick slices and serve immediately.
